messages:
jonatan_dev: Heads up — embeddings-prod-eu spiked 500s and returned 503s at 09:07 UTC. Root cause: header-parser stuck loop + kvcache pressure. Built hotfix image v3.2.7-hotfix. Requesting expedited deploy. Recommend skip full canary and do micro-canary (1%) then promote if green. Need ops + sre.

deploy-bot: Deploy request created: service=embeds-prod-eu image=v3.2.7-hotfix requested_by=jonatan_dev. Default policy: canary=10%. To request skip-canary or custom canary set `--canary` flag. Approvals required: 2. Approve with `/approve deploy 1765032100` or react :white_check_mark:.

lia_sre: Can we avoid skipping canary entirely? 10% is heavy for this service during the spike. 1% micro-canary + 5m soak then promote seems safer. Also need prometheus snapshot pre-deploy.

patrick_ops: Agree with lia. I'll only sign off if rollback image and smoke playbook posted here. Also will sit on pager for 60m.

jonatan_dev: rollback image set to v3.2.6-stable. No DB migrations, no config changes. Rollback steps: ```# rollback quick steps deployctl rollback --service embeds-prod-eu --image v3.2.6-stable wait-for-stable && kubectl scale deployment embeds-prod-eu --replicas=3``` Full runbook: https://playbooks/internal/embeds-rollback (shortlink).

sasha_pm: Impact: some EU customers seeing failed embeddings in batches — product approves expedited path with micro-canary. :+1:

release-bot: Generated draft release note: "hotfix(embeds): fix header parser loop causing 503s in EU (v3.2.7-hotfix)" URL: https://internal/releases/1765032100-edit

lia_sre: /approve deploy 1765032100 — approving conditioned on micro-canary 1% and 5m observation window.

patrick_ops: /approve deploy 1765032100 — approving. I'll monitor logs and have rollback command ready.

deploy-bot: Approvals (2) received. Initiating rollout with canary=1% -> monitor=5m -> promote. Command: ```deployctl rollout start --service embeds-prod-eu --image v3.2.7-hotfix --canary 1 --timeout 5m --requester jonatan_dev```

deploy-bot: Canary pods started: embeds-prod-eu-v3-2-7-1 (Ready). Telemetry stream: https://telemetry/internal/embeds/1765032100-canary

deploy-bot: Canary 1% metrics after 5m: errors=0, p99=410ms (baseline 420ms), kvcache misses normalized. No anomalous traces. Promoting to 100% per policy.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Deployment SUCCESS. Link: https://deployments.redwood/1765032100

jonatan_dev: Thanks — watching dashboards for 60m. If anything spikes, i'll trigger the rollback steps above.

patrick_ops: Monitoring — no alerts at 09:30 UTC. Keeping pager for another 30m.

lia_sre: Added short-term alert: p99 delta > 25% OR error rate > 0.5% for 30m.

sasha_pm: Release note updated and sent to comms. Thanks all. :tada:
